note: Every skill-package script that climbs out of its own package with a literal relative-path chain, with the reason the read exists. Flat installs break these chains silently; the guard keeps the list honest. Test suites are not listed: <skill>/test/** is exempt.

allowed.reason: First candidate source of the blueprint catalog for the preflight freshness line; a miss falls through to the network catalog URLs, so an install without the repo checkout is correct behaviour, not a failure.
Default --spec for the Field registry generator, which reads the blueprint Field definitions; a missing spec exits 2 with blueprint not found, so a flat install must pass --spec explicitly.

Reference catalog the compiler reads at import time. Installed flat (~/.agents/skills/nn-conntent) the four climbs land on ~/.agents/catalog, where a stale orphan copy was read silently: renders produced silent audio and only died later at caption alignment.

Resource read of the blueprint package root, which is then joined with library/components; installed flat the climbs land on ~/.agents and the portfolio silently comes back empty instead of the blueprint components.

Third and last candidate of findBlueprintPackage, after the two package-relative ones; each candidate is probed with existsSync(spec_NN.md) and a miss falls through to the next, so this dead candidate path is correct behaviour and the target below is informational only.
